digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: A coordinated quiet-window maintenance operation must reclaim ~1 GiB of spent disk from tickets-store git history and reduce the filtered pack below 131072 KiB via history rewrite, repack, and gc while preserving tree/commit/merge counts and identity.
The repair of bug 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must complete with zero repairable diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records before the history rewrite begins.

The operation requires backup/verification via off-repo bundles before and after the repair, with the final bundle's old tip matching exactly the rewrite lease source and publication using force-with-lease to prevent resurrection.

All writer services (GitHub workflows, AWS timer, LaunchAgents, rebar-mcp servers) must remain paused until operator confirms zero active sessions, and the deterministic first post-rewrite write must occur with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off to measure size growth accurately.

The rewritten history must preserve the old-tip tree, commit count, merge count, and identity multiset (event_uuid/verdict/grandfathered tuples), pass identity equivalence, and result in a fresh clone under 150 MiB with no old-tip ancestry.

Rollback is an explicit second quiet window requiring the operator to restore the final bundle, revert rebar.toml enforce_since via Gerrit review, verify identity equivalence, and re-enable writers only after confirming state matches the pre-window receipt.
